title: Check yourself: Prerequisite chains, limits, hand-offs and the practice

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: A refund gate becomes stricter after three failed identity checks: it now refuses every protected step. A locked-out customer's chat loops until the turn limit. What went wrong?

options.text: The lock should have waited for ten failures instead of three
options.says: Ruled out because the number of failures is not what looped the chat, and a lock is needed at all: without it, "a person who is guessing at an identity code, or a model that is being led to guess, gets unlimited tries". The loop came from the dead end: "An agent that cannot verify identity and is also barred from escalating is a dead end that loops until the turn limit".

options.text: The route to a person depended on the same safeguard that had tripped
options.says: An escape route must not sit behind a prerequisite that may be what failed.

options.text: The turn limit should have been set a lot lower
options.says: Ruled out because a lower limit only shortens a dead end: "An agent that cannot verify identity and is also barred from escalating is a dead end that loops until the turn limit".

options.text: The model should have been asked to hand the case over on its own
options.says: Ruled out because asking does not open a route: handing over is a tool call, and it only works when "one tool outside the gate, `escalate`, which is always allowed" exists.

origin.section: The way out must stay open

questions.stem: A refund over the limit is escalated with the full chat transcript attached, and reviewers spend minutes finding what was verified and what was blocked. Which change helps most?

options.text: Keep the transcript, but have the model highlight its key lines
options.says: Ruled out because the model is again choosing what the reviewer sees: "The gate's state is the source for what was verified, looked up and refunded; the model's account of them is not."

options.text: Attach a model-written summary of the conversation beside the full transcript
options.says: Ruled out because "A summary written by the model can leave out what went wrong."

options.text: Add the customer's complete order history to the escalation
options.says: Ruled out because a record carries only what is needed: "identifiers and amounts, not the whole order contents".

options.text: Send a gate-built record, with the agent's reason as one field
options.says: The gate holds the facts, and a record answers the reviewer's questions in a fixed place.
